title: Training Note: Unchanged-Terms Points on a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Late-Posted Charge
content:
**Training note, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

**Rule.** When the contract's ledger shows no extension and no due-date change, 0.5 percentage points are taken off the late-posted rate; when it shows no extension but at least one due-date change, 0.25 points are taken off; in every other case no points are taken off.

The ledger is read over the whole life of the contract; an extension entry or a due-date change entry of any date counts. The points come off the late-posted rate that applies to the contract, which is then applied once to one monthly payment.

| Ledger shows | Points taken off |
|---|---|
| no extension, no due-date change | 0.5 |
| no extension, one or more due-date changes | 0.25 |
| at least one extension | 0 |

## Basis Q&A

**Does a due-date change count against the contract as an extension does?** No: a contract with due-date changes but no extension still takes 0.25 points off; only an extension removes the points entirely.
